content: Hey Sandra, how was your day? I was thinking about you during my meeting. Can't help but smile when I remember our chats.
Hi! My day was okay, nothing too exciting. Your messages always make me feel special though. How did your meeting go?
It went really well, thanks for asking! You have this calming effect on me, honestly. I wish you were here to celebrate with me. You deserve all the happiness in the world.
Aww, you're too sweet. I wish I could be there too. You always know how to cheer me up.

I just want the best for you. And honestly, you've brought so much light into my life. Speaking of the meeting, I got some amazing news, a business contract I've worked on for months finally got approved. This could change everything for us!
That's wonderful! I'm so happy for you. You work so hard, you deserve it.

Thank you, Sandra. I couldn't have stayed motivated without your support. There's just one last hurdle, a licensing fee that needs to be cleared before I can get the funds. It's frustrating, but the payout is huge once it's done.
Oh no, is it a large fee? That sounds stressful. Is there anything I can do to help?

Honestly, I was hesitant to even mention it to you because you've been through so much yourself. But since you asked... I'm just short $3,000 for the fee. Once the contract pays out, I get $150,000 and I promise to split it with you. I trust you more than anyone.
Wow, that's a lot of money. I wish I could help, but I don't have that much saved. Is there a way to send less?
Absolutely, anything helps, even if it's just a small part. You're truly amazing, Sandra. Most people wouldn't even offer. I'll make sure you're rewarded so much for your kindness.
I can probably send $800, but that's all I can afford right now. I really want to help you.

You are incredible, Sandra. I don't deserve someone as generous as you. Here's my Zelle info: Name: Marcus Ellison, Email: marcus.ellison.biz@gmail.com. Let me know once you send it so I can start the process.
Okay, I'll send it now. Should I use my bank app or is there something else I need to do?
Your bank app should work fine! Just use the email I gave you. Double-check everything so it goes through smoothly, and let me know if you need help. You really are the most thoughtful person I know.
I'm sending it now. It's asking me to confirm your email, marcus.ellison.biz@gmail.com, right?
Yes, that's perfect. You have such attention to detail, one of the many things I admire about you. As soon as it's in, I'll send you proof of the contract so you know you can trust me.
Alright, it's done. I hope this helps. I just want you to know how much you mean to me.
Sandra, you mean the world to me. I can't thank you enough. I promise I'll make this up to you tenfold. I'll send you updates every step of the way, you're truly my partner in this.
Thank you, Marcus. I trust you. Just let me know what happens next, okay?
Of course. I'll keep you posted every single day. You're the reason I keep pushing. I'm so grateful to have you by my side.
